issue: spec max_seq_len 262144 is 51.2 chunks of 5120, but the whole-cache block-cyclic rope and KV table tile by chunk
fix: added spec.cache_capacity = ceil(max_seq_len/chunk_size)*chunk_size = 266240; max_seq_len stays the servable context

issue: donor rope _delta said Mistral takes HF yarn float correction dims, but HF defaults truncate=True when the key is absent
fix: verified against _compute_yarn_parameters: use floor/ceil (truncate=True) for Mistral; exposed as a rope arg

issue: FABRIC_1D_RING + the torus descriptor cannot map on this pod: it is a plain 8x4 grid with no wrap-around links
fix: default to FABRIC_1D + single_bh_galaxy_mesh descriptor with ttnn.Topology.Linear; MISTRAL_LINEAR_FABRIC=0 selects the torus

issue: the system mesh presents as 8x4 but the spec targets mesh (4,8) with tp on the cols
fix: ttnn.open_mesh_device(MeshShape(4,8)) reshapes the 8x4 system mesh view; verified both shapes open

issue: ttnn.rms_norm throws at hidden 12288: its interleaved kernel CBs grow to 2565120 B over the 1572864 B L1 budget
fix: composed the norm from multiply/mean/rsqrt with an fp32 sum of squares; width-independent, PCC 0.99999

why: Mistral has no QK-norm: Ministral3Attention builds no q_norm/k_norm and the config has no use_qk_norm
dense model: no MoE router, no experts, so there is no fused gate to test
dense model: every layer is a plain SwiGLU MLP, so there is no expert-parallel MoE

issue: donor projections call ttnn.linear with default compute config; at hidden 12288 / inter 28672 bf16 dest accumulation caps a layer at 0.989
fix: added get_matmul_compute_config (HiFi4, fp32_dest_acc_en=True) for QKV/o_proj/MLP; layer PCC 0.989 -> 0.996

issue: donor casts the SDPA output to bf8 before o_proj; measured worth 2e-5 PCC and it obscures the accumulation problem
fix: dropped the cast from apply_output_projection and recorded the measured cost in its docstring

issue: the published 128B checkpoint is unreachable from this host, so the M1 ground-truth row had nothing real to load
fix: wrote make_synthetic_checkpoint.py emitting the checkpoints exact on-disk format (fp8 + scales + wrapper prefix) as the loader oracle

issue: the spec pcc 0.99 is unreachable on the residual stream at depth: a bf16 CPU forward of the same weights scores 0.92-0.99 there
fix: gate per-layer KV at 0.99 (passes at 0.997) and gate the residual stream on tracking a bf16 reference within 0.01

issue: the 2D vocab-parallel embedding returns wrong rows above 4096 tokens per chunk, silently: layer 0 KV PCC 0.995 with nothing raised
fix: defaulted to the 1D hidden-only sharding (exact at 5120) and added a test pinning the 2D defect at its 4096-token boundary

issue: donor ProgramConfig sets fp32_dest_acc_en=False for every SDPA, but that constraint only applies to the ring cache-read op
fix: defaulted the plain-SDPA compute config to fp32 accumulation; one-shot L3 KV PCC 0.957 -> 0.978

why: single-rank only: no pipeline-parallel split, so there are no per-stage layouts to merge

issue: the engine reads runtime.config.use_trace and passes prefill_chunk(metadata_msg=), neither of which the gpt_oss_d_p donor runtime has
fix: added the use_trace field (False) and an ignored metadata_msg kwarg; both kill the runner at startup otherwise

issue: the shared producer read-back branch was named for gpt-oss but its logic is generic dense GQA
fix: renamed it _read_slot_kv_and_check_pcc_dense_gqa and dispatched both model names to it, dims from ADAPTER.model_config

issue: the table keys on GLOBAL token position but addresses RAW cache rows, and the block-cyclic layout is not the identity past one chunk
fix: invert blockcyclic_positions to map global position to shard row before comparing; a bank block is 32 consecutive shard rows

issue: the shared e2e test forces PREFILL_ENABLE_LAYER_ACK=1 and PREFILL_LAYER_ACK_D2H=1, which both donor runtimes reject outright
fix: implemented the D2H ack: one outbound_socket_service_sync per layer, mutually exclusive with the host channel; 22/22 acks drained

issue: prefill_producer resolves its adapter from PREFILL_MODEL only and never reads PREFILL_MANIFEST, so it silently ran as the default MLA model
fix: export PREFILL_MODEL and PREFILL_SP/TP alongside PREFILL_MANIFEST; noted in the manifest itself
